name: Stair Battles!
desc:
⚒️ Welcome to Stair Battles!
A game where you battle and build for the trophy!

🧱 Build your stairs before your enemy does!
💥 Shoot your enemies and their stairs with different RPGs!
💪 Upgrade and buy different weapons to become stronger!
🏆 The first one to reach the trophy wins!

🥸 Inspired by Bridge Builders & Bridge Battles

👍 Like and favorite the game!
📱 Supports Desktop, Mobile and all other platforms!
